config.toolbarSubtitle: profile {profile} · official key / custom endpoint / third-party providers (dsh watches this file; changes take effect immediately)
config.officialSubtitle: Official API key or a custom Messages-compatible endpoint
config.removeOfficialConfirm: Remove the llm-deepseek entry? This route will be removed from the dsh configuration (the key is cleaned up if nothing else references it)
config.officialNotConfigured: Not configured: dsh uses the built-in deepseek-flash / deepseek-v4-pro catalog but has no API key credential, so requests fail with MISSING_CREDENTIAL
config.restoreConfirm: Restore the built-in catalog? The current custom model catalog will be removed entirely (deepseek-flash / deepseek-v4-pro return)
config.emptyProviders: No third-party providers configured. Click "Add provider" to write the llm-pi-ai providers map.
config.deleteProviderConfirm: Delete this provider? The default model pointer will fall back to the official provider or the first remaining provider
config.modelsEmpty: No models yet (this route is unavailable in dsh; add one)
config.footerHint: API keys are not written to cordis.patch.yml: entries only record a reference name derived from the route name (e.g. NEWAPI_API_KEY). Plaintext keys are stored in the refs map of ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml (records authorization entries are preserved as-is).
config.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: Saved; clear and save to delete, or modify to overwrite
config.credentialHint: The key is written to refs[{env}] in ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml (the reference name is derived automatically; nothing to fill in)
config.baseUrl: Base URL (baseURL; leave empty for the official default)
config.baseUrlHint: The custom endpoint must be Messages-compatible: dsh appends /v1/messages to the root URL (a trailing /v1 is reused directly)
config.officialCatalogHint: The model catalog is maintained separately in the card via "Add model / Edit model" (turning off the custom catalog falls back to the built-in deepseek-flash / deepseek-v4-pro)
config.routeHintLocked: The route name is the providers key and cannot be changed (to rename, delete and re-add)
config.routeHint: Lowercase letters / digits / hyphens only; also used to derive the credential reference name (NEWAPI_API_KEY)
config.baseUrlHintProtocol: For the OpenAI Chat protocol the SDK appends /chat/completions, so the Base URL must include /v1; for Anthropic Messages it appends /v1/messages automatically, so enter the root URL
config.thinkingFormat: Thinking parameter format (compat.thinkingFormat; leave empty to auto-detect)
config.firstModelHint: Hand-written routes require a non-empty models list, so the first model is written now; add the remaining models and context/output limits in the card
config.modelFetchHint: Candidates come from this route's Base URL /models endpoint; you can also enter one manually
config.inputTypes: Input types (text is supported by default)
config.emptyCatalogSuffix: (the catalog is empty; it will be written after adding)
config.editExtFieldsHint: When changing the model ID, other extension fields on the entry (description / systemPromptUpdate / reasoningEfforts, etc.) are preserved
config.officialFirstModelHint: Adding the first model to the official route switches it from the built-in catalog to a custom catalog
config.piAiFieldsHint: Other pi-ai fields on the entry (reasoningEfforts / compat / headers, etc.) are preserved
config.noBaseUrl: No Base URL configured; cannot fetch models automatically

provider.routeInvalid: The route name may contain only lowercase letters / digits / hyphens and cannot start or end with a hyphen
provider.firstModelRequired: Enter the first model ID (hand-written pi-ai routes require a non-empty models list)

model.alreadyExists: Model {id} is already in the catalog
model.deletedRestored: Model {modelId} deleted; reverted to the built-in model catalog

usage.empty: No usage data yet. It will appear here after you chat with DSH.
usage.emptyHint: Session logs not found: {path}. After usage is recorded, re-enter this page or click Refresh to collect statistics.
usage.modelHint: Model names use the model ID only; same-name models across routes are merged
